SFB16 2025 Season — Exploratory Data Analysis

Season Total Distributions

By Position

Code 
season_main |>
  filter(games_played >= 3) |>
  mutate(position = factor(position, levels = main_pos)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = total_sfb16_fpts, fill = position)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 25, color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_rug(aes(color = position), alpha = 0.4, linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pos_colors, guide = "none") +
  scale_color_manual(values = pos_colors, guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = label_comma()) +
  facet_wrap(~position, ncol = 2, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Season SFB16 Points by Position",
    subtitle = "Binwidth = 25 pts · ≥ 3 games played",
    x = "Season SFB16 Points", y = "Players"
  ) +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13, color = "grey20"))

Position Comparison

Code 
season_main |>
  filter(games_played >= 8) |>
  mutate(position = factor(position, levels = main_pos)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = position, y = total_sfb16_fpts, fill = position, color = position)) +
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.2, linewidth = 0, width = 0.8) +
  geom_boxplot(
    width = 0.18, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.75,
    color = "grey30", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.14, alpha = 0.35, size = 1.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pos_colors, guide = "none") +
  scale_color_manual(values = pos_colors, guide = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = label_comma()) +
  labs(
    title = "Season SFB16 Points by Position",
    subtitle = "Players with ≥ 8 games played",
    x = NULL, y = "Season SFB16 Points"
  )

Top 30 Players

Code 
season_main |>
  slice_max(total_sfb16_fpts, n = 30) |>
  mutate(label = paste0(player_name, " (", team, ")") |> fct_reorder(total_sfb16_fpts)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = total_sfb16_fpts, y = label, fill = position)) +
  geom_col(alpha = 0.85, width = 0.75) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = comma(round(total_sfb16_fpts, 1))),
    hjust = -0.08, size = 3.5, color = "grey20"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pos_colors) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.14)),
    labels = label_comma()
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Top 30 Players — SFB16 Season Totals",
    x = "Season SFB16 Points", y = NULL, fill = NULL
  ) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "top"
  )

Consistency: Weekly Top-10 Finishes

Code 
season_main |>
  slice_max(total_sfb16_fpts, n = 30) |>
  mutate(label = paste0(player_name, " (", team, ")") |> fct_reorder(top10_overall_weeks)) |>
  pivot_longer(
    c(top10_overall_weeks, top10_pos_weeks),
    names_to = "type", values_to = "count"
  ) |>
  mutate(type = recode(type,
    top10_overall_weeks = "Overall Top 10",
    top10_pos_weeks     = "Position Top 10"
  )) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = count, y = label, fill = type)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge", alpha = 0.85, width = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Overall Top 10" = "#2c7bb6", "Position Top 10" = "#abd9e9")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 0:18) +
  labs(
    title = "Weekly Top-10 Finish Counts — Top 30 Players",
    subtitle = "Overall (all positions) vs. within position · max 18 weeks",
    x = "Weeks in Top 10", y = NULL, fill = NULL
  ) +
  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())

Top 20 Players — Weekly Score Breakdown

Heatmap

Code 
top20_long |>
  ggplot(aes(x = week, y = player_label, fill = fpts)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_text(
    data = top20_long |> filter(!is.na(fpts)),
    aes(label = round(fpts, 0)),
    size = 2.7, color = "white", fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "#aed6f1", high = "#1a5276",
    na.value = "grey88",
    labels = label_comma(),
    guide  = guide_colorbar(barwidth = 12, barheight = 0.5, title.position = "top")
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:18, expand = expansion(0)) +
  labs(
    title    = "Top 20 Players — Weekly SFB16 Scores",
    subtitle = "Grey = bye / inactive · ordered by season total",
    x = "Week", y = NULL, fill = "Points"
  ) +
  theme(
    panel.grid  = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10)
  )

Weekly Score Distributions

Code 
top20_long |>
  ggplot(aes(x = fpts, y = player_label, fill = position, color = position)) +
  geom_boxplot(
    outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.3, width = 0.55,
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = top20_long |> filter(!is.na(fpts)),
    position = position_jitter(height = 0.18, seed = 42),
    alpha = 0.65, size = 2.2
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pos_colors) +
  scale_color_manual(values = pos_colors) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = label_comma()) +
  labs(
    title    = "Weekly Score Distributions — Top 20 Players",
    subtitle = "Box = IQR · Dots = individual weekly scores · ordered by season total",
    x = "Weekly SFB16 Points", y = NULL,
    fill = NULL, color = NULL
  ) +
  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())

Weekly Trajectories (Small Multiples)

Code 
top20_long |>
  ggplot(aes(x = week, y = fpts)) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = fpts), na.rm = TRUE, width = 0.85) +
  geom_hline(
    data = per_game_avg,
    aes(yintercept = mean_fpts),
    linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.55
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "#aed6f1", high = "#1a5276",
    na.value = "transparent", guide = "none"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(1, 6, 12, 18)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = label_comma()) +
  facet_wrap(~facet_label, ncol = 4) +
  labs(
    title    = "Weekly SFB16 Scores — Top 20 Players",
    subtitle = "Dashed line = per-game average",
    x = "Week", y = "Points"
  ) +
  theme(
    strip.text         = element_text(face = "bold", size = 8.5),
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.spacing      = unit(0.8, "lines")
  )
